automation.title: Automatic answers
automation.intro: Answers sent for your team when a customer writes, marked in the chat as automatic. They go inside the 24 hours the customer just opened, never to someone who asked to stop, and the chat still waits for a person to reply. Once a person replies in a chat, the answers pause there for 12 hours.
automation.saveCovers: Saves the away message with its hours, and the welcome message.
automation.awayIntro: Sent when someone writes outside your office hours, at most once in 12 hours a chat.
automation.awayPlaceholder: Thanks for writing! Our office is closed now. We will reply first thing in the morning.
automation.welcomeIntro: Sent to a number writing to you for the first time.
automation.welcomePlaceholder: Hello! Thanks for contacting us. Tell us where you want to travel and someone will help you shortly.
automation.keywordsIntro: When a customer's message has this word, the answer goes at once, at most once in 12 hours a chat. For example: price, itinerary, visa.

tripKits.intro: Set up each trip once: its itinerary, price and payment details, with its photos, videos and PDFs. When a customer's message has one of its keywords, the trip goes to them by itself, once a chat. Anyone in the inbox can send it from a chat's Send details.
